Applying the exam-realism test, an exam paper prints no figure for 'substitute into this given formula' questions (a figure appears only when a shape/graph is presented without the formula). The opener (taxi fare) claims no figure, so it needs none. figures_added = 0 is the correct, honest outcome for this lesson.
